verdict.rationale: Link CLI gives an agent access to a customer-controlled Link wallet. The agent requests one-time-use virtual cards or SPTs, which the user approves per request, and it can read balances and transactions from the bank and card accounts the user chooses to share. SPTs add issuer-set limits on amount, currency and expiry, plus revocation. However, this is a credential broker over the user's existing payment methods, not a funded wallet the agent holds with its own balance, and every spend needs human approval rather than autonomous spending within a budget. Missing for 10: a prefunded, agent-held wallet balance that the user tops up; autonomous spend-from-balance within user-set limits; visibility of the wallet's own balance (as distinct from connected-account balances); independent hands-on corroboration.
